title: feat(workflow_engine): Add in hook for producing occurrences from the stateful detector

comments.text: Paraphrase: MetricAlertDetectorHandler subclasses StatefulDetectorHandler with only pass, so it doesn't implement the abstract methods counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values, and build_occurrence_and_event_data. The class therefore cannot be instantiated.
Paraphrase: The hardcoded value 6 for group_2 is inconsistent with the test data, which gives group_2 a value of 10. The suggested change is to use 10 in the build_mock_occurrence_and_event call.
Paraphrase: The test builds its expected result with 'val1' and value 6, which doesn't match the group_key parameter 'group_key'. This may be a test logic error.
